summary.text: Broken Homes and Dead Family is an immortal killer move Li Huang names when Chicken Dog Coop breaks apart and the Gu Immortals inside die.

claims.text: After people’s united hearts, Old Man Zheng Yuan burns immortal essence as the key to activate another human path method left by an Immortal Venerable. A faint white light flashes on Emperor City. Chicken Dog Coop’s ferocious aura vanishes. The Immortal Gu House breaks apart and disintegrates like an old house in ferocious winds, shards scattering, Gu worms and corpses falling. The Fang clan Gu Immortals who were lively inside a moment earlier do not answer when called. Fang Yuan’s expression changes: with one hit the house broke apart and not a single Gu Immortal inside survived. Even in the five hundred years of his previous life, such a thing had never happened. Li Huang’s eyes shine. He names the immortal killer move and takes it as a sign that human will has already been accumulated sufficiently. People’s united hearts and this move are Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable’s human path methods.

Divine Emperor City shoots out rays of white light from time to time. Calamity Luck Altar has to dodge them without being careless. The move counters Immortal Gu Houses. During the fate war, Chicken Dog Coop was only grazed by it, and the entire house broke apart without a single Gu Immortal inside surviving.
